newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products steady, except softer fuel oil.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products steady, except softer fuel oil.

text.p: NWE oil products were steady on Friday except high sulphur fuel oil which dipped after the key market prop exited, dealers said.

High sulphur fuel oil barges traded at $88 and $88.50 fob ARA with late morning offers at $89 fob Rotterdam. The trading house that has supported the market for the past week bought one barge, but traders said there was no evidence that it wanted prices higher any longer.
Bunker demand was fair, with 10-15,000 tonnes of enquiries.
Gasoline was barely changed from Thursday's close. In a quiet market Eurograde offers were at around $216/$217 fob. Only one would-be buyer was identified, willing to bid $215/$216.
April swaps dipped from late Thursday's highs of $217.75 fob ARA.

Heating oil barges were very thinly discussed. Prompt deliveries were offered at April IPE -$1.50 fob ARA, but few predicted buying before the end of the month. April deliveries were valued at around April IPE flat.
